name: What permits are required for kitchen addition framing in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for kitchen addition framing in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: For kitchen addition framing in Bay Area cities like Pacifica, Daly City, or South San Francisco, you will generally need a building permit. Depending on the scope, additional permits for electrical, plumbing, or mechanical work may also be required. Local planning departments review architectural plans to ensure compliance with zoning regulations, seismic codes, and structural integrity standards. Our team assists with navigating the permit application process to ensure all necessary approvals are secured before construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Building permits are typically required for kitchen addition framing in Bay Area cities, often alongside electrical, plumbing, or mechanical permits.
